messages:
rita: starting a config-only push during change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. this is routing + timeout + batch micro-tune. canary plan: 2% for 10m, 10% for 10m, 50% for 10m, then 100%.

deploy-bot: /deploy config-only --name safety-fence-microconfig --changes "routing.fanout=conservative; batching.window_ms=25; timeouts.request_ms=10000; tenant.concurrency_floor=2" --canary 2%:10m,10%:10m,50%:10m --window 02:00-04:00 UTC

sam: small ask 1 are we excluding enterprise tenants with custom routing?

rita: yes excluding tenants tagged `enterprise-custom`. will add exclusion list to the job.

lee: paging thresholds: p95 latency > 450ms for 2 consecutive 5m -> auto-throttle canary by 50%. error rate > 1% -> immediate rollback.

ops-bot: note: model variant pinned to rtx-v1.9 for rollout. config change will not touch model weights.

rita: adding runbook snippets: watch tenant-level qps, kvcache eviction, deploy-bot events. sam, can you watch billing-limits?

sam: will monitor prepaid tenant throttles. will post to #user-impact if anything anomalous.

lee: snippet for quick revert:
```bash
/deploy config-only --name safety-fence-microconfig --action revert --target previous
```

rita: checklist:
- deploy command submitted
- enterprise-custom excluded
- model pinned rtx-v1.9
- obs runbook assigned (lee first 30m, sam billing)
- rollback triggers defined

deploy-bot: job queued, id d3a1f. will post status updates. :gear:

ops-bot: created temp dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/safety-fence/microconfig-canary

rita: starting in ~8m, tagging on-call @lee @sam.

deploy-bot: canary start at 8087654330, 2% active

lee: first 6m: latency flat, small bump in kvcache misses for one noisy tenant, not impacting p95.

sam: prepaid tenants clear. no billing events.

deploy-bot: advanced to 10% at 8087654338

rita: proceeding to 50% after hold if metrics stay steady.

deploy-bot: advanced to 50% at 8087654339

lee: during 50% we saw one spike to p95 480ms for a 5m bucket, but was isolated to a single non-excluded dev tenant. not triggering rollback.

deploy-bot: rollout complete at 8087654340

sam: tagging release note: "config: safety-fence-microconfig 1 conservative routing fanout, 25ms batch window, 10s request timeout, concurrency floor 2; model pinned rtx-v1.9"

rita: thanks all. closing thread. will follow up if any post-release regressions appear.
